key_fields.name: DCLTRANSACTION-TYPE
key_fields.meaning: DCLGEN host structure for one row of CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE.

key_fields.name: DCL-TR-TYPE
key_fields.meaning: Host variable for column TR_TYPE CHAR(2) NOT NULL - the 2-character transaction type code (table key per usage in WHERE clauses).

key_fields.name: DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION
key_fields.meaning: VARCHAR host group for column TR_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL.

key_fields.name: DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION-LEN
key_fields.meaning: Binary length prefix (S9(4) COMP) of the VARCHAR description.

observations.text: The table is qualified with the literal schema CARDDEMO and the DCLGEN library comment names a personal dataset (SNJARAO.AWS.DCL); the schema is not parameterised.
COBTUPDT includes this copybook but binds its own X(50) working-storage fields instead of DCL-TR-DESCRIPTION-LEN/TEXT, so the length prefix is not used there.

purpose: DB2 DCLGEN output for table CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE: an EXEC SQL DECLARE TABLE statement with columns TR_TYPE CHAR(2) and TR_DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(50), both NOT NULL, plus the COBOL host structure DCLTRANSACTION-TYPE. It is included (EXEC SQL INCLUDE DCLTRTYP) by the transaction type maintenance programs COBTUPDT, COTRTLIC and COTRTUPC as the host-variable layout for the reference table of transaction type codes and their descriptions.
